goal:

breaking-граница по D85: aliases, forwarding classes и автоматический Composer `replace` не
добавляются. Поведение, persisted identifiers, config keys и artisan signatures сохраняются,
если отдельное принятое решение явно не говорит обратного.

остальная фаза от них не блокируется.

> машинно проверенный zero-old-name receipt. Не производит: совместимые aliases, DB migrations,
> новое поведение или структурный profile rollout P16.

# Закрытие фазы P15

> Не править руками: это генерируемый вид.

## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: materialized P1 rename registry; терминальные
P6/P9/P10/P13 и их receipts; принятые D85–D88; owner evidence для conditional package items.
Производит: namespace-coherent rename set, обновлённые metadata/docs/root CHANGELOG и
машинно проверенный zero-old-name receipt. Не производит: совместимые aliases, DB migrations,
новое поведение или структурный profile rollout P16.

## Произведено

- P15.1 — Modules vocabulary и ModuleDefinition: Renamed modules surface, updated consumers/tests/metadata and item receipt with nine discovery results.
- P15.2 — Attributes vocabulary: Четыре renamed definitions с обновлёнными consumers/tests и receipt completeness.
- P15.3 — Search unavailable provider: Renamed provider exception and item receipt.
- P15.4 — Meilisearch provider vocabulary: Renamed Meilisearch provider with green wiring receipt.
- P15.5 — Transfer executor and sink: Renamed executor/sink graph and receipt.
- P15.6 — Tasks Workflow integration vocabulary: Renamed Tasks Workflow classes and discovery receipt.
- P15.7 — Wakeup public contract vocabulary: Complete wakeup vocabulary rollout and consumer/manifest receipt.
- P15.8 — API operation class vocabulary: Four API class renames and wire-invariance receipt.
- P15.9 — Tenancy available accounts result: Renamed result class and compatibility receipt.
- P15.10 — Core semantic-zone FQCN moves: Five semantic-zone moves and group-by-group receipt.
- P15.11 — Conditional API package identity rename: Accepted identity rename or skipped receipt with owner evidence.
- P15.12 — Conditional Auth package identity rename: Accepted identity rename or skipped receipt with owner evidence.
- P15.13 — Registry and surface reconciliation: Reconciled surfaces, root release note and machine-readable completeness input with receipt.
- P15.14 — P15 full qualification and negative completeness proof: `@plan/knowledge/findings-P15-receipts.json`, refreshed generated plan views and provider-neutral Next to P16 design only.

## Known Deviations

- P15.13: Item commit withheld on dirty worktree overlapping P15.1–P15.12.
- P15.14: P15.14 qualification green. Planted P15C removed. Arch 89, packages green. strict-psr residual exit 1. Receipt findings/P15-receipts.md.

sections.title: Scope Included
sections.text:
- Modules: `Dep`, его поля, `Manifest`, `GateDecision`, `SettingDefault`,
  `ModuleContext`, `CorexModule`, `WhyCommand` и девять module consumers.
- Attributes, Search, Meilisearch, Transfer, Tasks Workflow, Wakeup, API и Tenancy mappings из
  `@plan/knowledge/research-P15-design.json` §2.
- Core-zone public FQCN moves из D88.
- Conditional package identity/directory/split rename для API/Auth строго по D89/D90 owner
  outcome.
- Public API manifests, autoload metadata, architecture allowlists, PHPStan, docs/examples и
  только корневой `CHANGELOG.md`.
- Final planted-old-name negative gate и phase receipt.

sections.title: Validation
sections.text:
Каждый rename lane проходит package lint/analyse/test и `composer dump-autoload --strict-psr`.
Финал проходит root architecture/package graph/public API/naming gates и `composer
test:packages`. Для каждого old name машинный sweep пуст вне разрешённых historical/design
carriers. Negative fixture со старым именем обязана уронить completeness gate и после удаления
вернуть green. Module discovery доказывает все девять module entries; artisan
`corex:modules:why` и persisted composer module ids неизменны. Skipped check не считается green.

sections.title: Phase Handoff
sections.text: P15.1–P15.14 are terminal. P15.11 and P15.12 executed (D89/D90 accepted); nothing in the phase was skipped. Completeness gate is green after a planted `P15C` failure on `CorexModule` was removed. Root arch, package graph, public API, naming and `composer test:packages` are green. `composer dump-autoload --optimize --strict-psr` stays exit 1 on pre-existing test doubles and is not a green check. Successor is P16.1, not another P15 design pass.
